ai_summary: Ratnaveer Precision Engineering Limited reported strong Q1 FY27 results, exhibiting significant year-over-year and sequential growth in both revenue and net profit, supported by a clean limited review report. However, a material red flag exists as the reported Earnings Per Share (EPS) of Rs. 10.36 for the quarter appears inconsistent with the reported net profit and paid-up equity capital figures, suggesting potential data presentation issues that warrant further clarification for investors.
